sentences.en: There's a black hole at the center of our galaxy.
sentences.zh: 我们的银河系中心有一个黑洞。

sentences.en: The universe contains all of the galaxies, stars, and planets.
sentences.zh: 宇宙包含了所有的星系、恒星和行星。

sentences.en: The Andromeda galaxy is over 2 million light-years away from us.
sentences.zh: 仙女座星系距离我们超过200万光年。
